QuestInfo.name: King Sage Cat's Call
QuestInfo.0: As soon as I reach #b#m250010503##k, I can faintly hear a voice coming out of there...
QuestInfo.1: Out of the blue, the #rKing Sage Cat#k reached out to you. He claims he's not malicious, only misunderstood. Is he telling the truth? Head over to the #bRock Support of the Disappeared Statue#k at #bGoblin Forest 2#k to find out.
QuestInfo.2: Supposedly, the King Sage Cat isn't after Mu Lung at all; that's just a rumor, he says, spready by Do Gong, who's jealous of the King Sage Cat's magical abilities. Talk to the King Sage Cat and see if you can find out the truth.

0.msg: Hey, traveler. I can tell you're from Do Gong, based on that hideous-looking item you've got there. Throw that away, and lend me your ear for a moment, okay? I'll be more than happy to dispel those nasty rumors about me. Just come closer... Heh heh.

You have entered the deepest part of Goblin Forest... But if you go through the #bstone base of the vanished statue in the Second Goblin Forest#k, it'll be a breeze. Please come find me right away. I'm eager to show you what I'm all about...
Are you turning down my invitation? That's... too bad. I really wanted to put these rumors to rest and get back on good terms with Mu Lung...

1.0: Ohhh, you're here! You're HERE, traveler! Of course, justice shall prevail in the end! Hehehehe... now, I shall break down the 'gap' between you and me. Allow me to separate the truth from fiction.

yes.0: What did Do Gong say about this King Sage Cats? I am sure he mentioned something about me being a threat to Mu Lung and all. What I want you to know here, however, is that I have NOTHING against Mu Lung at all. I mean, I am not human, but I also am a trained Master from Mu Lung. Why would I despise Mu Lung?
